author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Get 10% off your Manta Sleep purchase with code NOTMARK - https://tinyurl.com/Totally-Not-Mark

The Jujutsu Kaisen anime is a GREAT adaptation, but I also think it's the best way to experience the story. That's not the insult to Gege it might sound like! This is a breakdown of how one of the most talented production teams in the industry took everything the manga was aiming for and got it there in the most spectacular way possible.

Final Draft by @AnimeAjay
